name: Moon Girl and Devil Dinosaur — base P/T become 6/6 and they gain trample
notes: Found while fixing the 'base power and toughness become N/N' wording. 'they' is the two-in-one card itself. A keyword granted after a base-P/T clause used to take the whole clause as its subject ('This card has base power and toughness 6/6'), which is no permanent; the clause is now stripped from the subject. Moon Girl is 6/6 with trample; the Bears get neither. The second sentence of the draw trigger adds nothing.

call: until end of turn, this card's base power and toughness become 6/6 and they gain trample.
Whenever you draw your second card each turn, until end of turn, this card's base power and toughness become 6/6 and they gain trample.
